title: Connections
description: Contents of connections.json: sourced links between muscles, structures and pain regions, used by the pain search (S3.2) and its chain explanation (S3.3). Free-text fields are in Finnish.

type.description: shared_tissue: a shared tendon or fascia. attachment: one attaches to the other, or both share an attachment site. referred_pain: pain from the muscle may be felt in the region.

to.description: muscle:<id>, structure:<id>, or region:<id> (regions only for referred_pain).

evidence.description: anatomy: textbook anatomy. cadaver_study: dissection or histology studies. contested: clinical findings whose theoretical basis is disputed.

description.description: Shown to the user. Describes what the sources report; never says that something causes pain.

sources.description: Ids of entries in sources.json that support this connection.
